subject: Starlift Inc — Incubator credit ask & onboarding questions
messages:
From: Samira Kohli <samira@starlift.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Pierce <jordan@accelerata.vc>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intro + incubator credits?

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for taking the intro yesterday. Starlift is an early-stage startup building a composable multimodal search for life sciences teams. We’re part of a small New York incubator (two other companies are using your API under a separate trial) and are trying to move from prototype -> pilot with a pharma partner in Q3.

We’re hoping Redwood can support an incubator-stipend style credit for the next 6 months to cover API usage while we validate model accuracy and integration latency with real lab data. High-level: expect ~6–8 engineers, 5–10M tokens/month if we enable logging + retraining flows, spike to 15M/month during pilot.

Attached: pitch deck and a quick usage snapshot.

Two asks:
- What’s the typical incubator credit size you’d approve for a case like this?
- What qualification info do you need to speed approval?

Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Best,
Samira
Samira Kohli
Co‑Founder, Starlift Inc
samira@starlift.ai
+1 (347) 555-0198

Attachment: starlift_pitch_deck_v2.pdf (pdf, 2.3MB)
Attachment: starlift_usage_snapshot.csv (csv, 18KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samira Kohli <samira@starlift.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro + incubator credits?

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the deck and the usage snapshot — very helpful. Quick answers up front: we run an \"Incubator Stipend\" program for early teams and typically approve credits in the range of $10k–$60k depending on expected runway impact, token estimates, and whether the company needs dedicated capacity for low-latency pilot work. For a 6-month window with the token profile you mentioned, I’d estimate we’d recommend a conditional allocation around $25k–$40k in hosted credits, with the option to re-evaluate if you enter a paid pilot.

To move quickly I need two things from you:
1) a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones (pilot start date, evaluation metrics, point of contact on the pharma side)
2) a brief security/compliance note (is any PHI or regulated health data involved?) — if yes, we’ll need to scope Private or Dedicated options.

Cc’ing Lauren from Finance to confirm approval path and Monica from Solutions to flag any potential latency or model constraints we should prepare for before the pilot. If you can send the MAP and a 1‑paragraph data profile by EOD Thursday we should be able to do a preliminary sign-off and share terms.

Would you like a 30-minute slot tomorrow to draft the MAP together?

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_incubator_terms_v1.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Samira Kohli <samira@starlift.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro + incubator credits?

Hi all —

Thanks for looping me in. A few notes on the approval path from Finance:
- For incubator stipends we require an internal approval doc + a signed credit addendum (DocuSign) for audit purposes.
- Credits are issued as hosted-service usage credits against the HubSpot deal and expire after 6 months unless an extension is approved by GP (growth program) lead.
- Typical ledger allocation for a seed-stage incubator is $15,000–$40,000. For anything above $40k I need VP/leadership sign-off.

Rishi — if you think $25k conditional is right, I can generate the addendum and the DocuSign package. Samira — one minor ask: please add a short line in the MAP clarifying the expected daily QPS and whether you need reserved concurrency. That helps Performance plan the right burst capacity.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Revenue Ops — Finance Liaison | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Hi Rishi / Lauren —

Thanks — yes this is great context. I pulled the MAP into the body below and added the QPS note. Also: none of the data we'll pass through Redwood is PHI, but some of the partner test datasets contain de‑identified genomic aggregates — if that changes anything on your end please flag.

Mutual Action Plan (rough):
- Week 1–2: Redwood sets up a hosted test workspace + 10k credits; Starlift engineers run integration tests (latency target < 250ms p50).
- Week 3–6: Pilot with pharma partner (closed test dataset); evaluation metric: retrieval F1 and end-to-end latency under load.
- Week 7–12: Pilot extension / go/no-go decision; discuss dedicated capacity if latency/throughput needed.
- Contact: Samira Kohli (samira@starlift.ai), Eng lead: Priya S.
- Expected baseline: 6–8 engineers, 5–10M tokens/month; peak 15M tokens/month.
- QPS: baseline 15 qps, peak 60 qps; will request reserved concurrency if pilot progresses.

If this looks OK I can sign the MAP and we can move to DocuSign. We’re hoping to start the integration in the first week of July (deadline is driven by the partner).

Thanks,
Samira

Hi Samira —

Excited to get Starlift moving. Based on the MAP and the usage snapshot, Growth Program is provisionally approving a $30,000 hosted-credit package, valid for 6 months from activation. Conditions:
1) Signed credit addendum (DocuSign) — Lauren will send;
2) Short 1‑page security attestation confirming no PHI and how genomic aggregates are stored/transmitted;
3) Monthly usage check-ins for the first 3 months; credits will be suspended if you exceed the token runway without an agreed plan.

Operational notes: Monica, can you please reserve a 60-qps burst policy for their account during pilot weeks 3–6 and add the account to our monitoring dashboard with alert thresholds at 80% of allocated burst?

Samira — I’ve started the DocuSign package here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-starlift-credit-agreement (link active for 7 days). If you can sign and return the security attestation within 72 hours we’ll provision a test workspace and activate a 10k kickstart credit for integration testing.

Looking forward —
Aditya Rao
